title: Twist 01
name: twist-01
arc:
The Twist. The figure rotates on the balls of the feet, the lifted foot swapping from character-left (frames 0-1, 5) to character-right (frame 6), arms out to the side and pumping opposite to the hips.

Pingpong: frames 0 and 11 are the turnarounds. Keep the knees bent and the heels turning.

frames.cue: Weight on the character-right foot, character-left foot lifted. character-left knee folded tight, character-right knee slightly bent. character-left arm at waist height, elbow straight, out to the side. character-right arm at shoulder height, elbow bent ~90°, across the body in front of the torso. torso leans character-right. character-left hip raised. hips turned character-left against the shoulders. head forward.
